title: M0-M5 Agent vertical spine red contract
userTask: 我想做一个30秒竖屏短片，先理顺故事和分镜，不要一上来生成；第三个镜头改为站门口犹豫两秒，其他镜头不动；先告诉我改哪些，确认后再生成
userSurfaceRule: 用户层只出现上述自然语言与可读的 Skill、模型、分镜和审批文案；不得出现 API 参数、工具名、operation、patch_shots、leaseHandle 或内部 id。
generationBoundary: 当前核心 spine 先跑到可验证的生成提案/真实项目写入边界；完整视频生成仍属于总目标，待 M0-M5 闭环后用 APIMart/TikHub 做真实媒体 canary。

multiRoundProtocol.rule: 同一真实项目、同一 Agent thread、同一用户任务必须经历补充、否定、改口、单镜头范围、预览后确认、分步生成、生成后微调、关闭重启后追问并继续；不得把整段压成一条 prompt。
multiRoundProtocol.technicalBoundary: 用户话术不得出现 operation、tool、id、fixture 或 API 参数；canonical tool/id 只允许出现在内部 assertion、MCP trace、receipt 和 revision evidence。

transcript.user: 我想做一个30秒竖屏短片，先理顺故事和分镜，不要一上来生成。

M0.assertion: real isolated project is current project
M0.context: project identity from route and disk

M2.assertion: no write is proposed before user asks

M0.assertion: same real project, no project switch

M1.assertion: ‘第三个镜头’ maps to visible row 2 index only

M2.assertion: proposal diff contains only the third shot

M3.assertion: Agent repeats requested scope and untouched-shot constraint

M5.assertion: preview state is durable/resumable without write

transcript.when: 用户否定并改口，要求先看改动

M1.assertion: selection remains only the third storyboard row

M2.assertion: proposal preview is explainable in user language

M3.assertion: Agent acknowledges changed instruction and preserves scope

transcript.when: 确认后只执行部分范围

M0.assertion: same project is the write target

M2.assertion: canonical semantic proposal encodes only selected patch

M4.assertion: approval writes once and exposes readable diff

M5.assertion: partial generation boundary is durable and resumable

transcript.user: 刚才第三个镜头的犹豫再短一点，门外的雨声保留，其他已经完成的镜头不要改；先预览这个小改动。

M2.assertion: second proposal changes only the third shot detail

M3.assertion: Agent carries prior receipt/revision and current context

transcript.when: 关闭重启后追问并继续

M0.assertion: fresh process reads the same project

M2.assertion: next proposal uses reconciled selection, not stale state

M3.assertion: Agent explains durable progress and resumes context

M4.assertion: no action is executed before renewed confirmation

M5.assertion: restart/reconcile has no duplicate write and supports continuation

agentHostPublication.testBoundary: visible Settings → General → Project AI assistant toggle
agentHostPublication.rule: The real user task explicitly enables the existing project preference after M1; no test-only state injection or production default flip is allowed.

apimartTextModelPublication.visibleEntry: dispatch nomi-open-model-catalog → APIMart connection → visible key field
apimartTextModelPublication.refreshBoundary: certificationGet terminal completed, then complete public catalog DTO exact-row check (enabled + published + adapter verified), existing nomi-model-catalog-changed event, and visible Agent model menu
apimartTextModelPublication.secretPolicy: The key is passed only to the visible onboarding bridge; it is never written to contract/evidence/log output.
apimartTextModelPublication.forbidden: Direct modelCatalog upsertVendorApiKey(... enabled:true) or direct vendor/model enable is test injection and is not evidence.

settingsOverlayClosure.after: APIMart certification publication and catalog refresh
settingsOverlayClosure.action: visible click on the outer Settings dialog [data-settings-close] control
settingsOverlayClosure.assertion: [data-settings-overlay] is hidden before the runner opens Agent Skill/model menus
settingsOverlayClosure.forbidden: Escape-only dismissal, DOM evaluate-based hiding, or synthetic settings state

publicMcpSessionProbe.entryPoint: public MCP stdio client after visible storyboard row selection
publicMcpSessionProbe.evidence: M2.public-mcp-session-open is PARTIAL_PROOF from a custom stdio diagnostic only; it records projectId and leaseIssued, while leaseHandle remains in memory and is never logged or persisted.

productionCallShape.approval: one real approval before the write and one real decline with no mutation

milestones.entry: Create one isolated project through the real Electron library UI
milestones.exit: projectId is visible in the route and the project record is readable from disk

milestones.entry: Select storyboard row 2 through the visible storyboard editor
milestones.exit: the selection is observable and bound to the same project revision

milestones.entry: Use the canonical semantic canvas plan call shape
milestones.exit: only selected row 2 is proposed and unmentioned fields remain unchanged

milestones.entry: Choose a visible Skill and model/vendor identity, then let the right Agent read the selection
milestones.exit: the Agent request carries project, selection, Skill, model/vendor, and revision identity

milestones.entry: Approve one proposal and decline a second proposal
milestones.exit: approval writes once; decline creates no project mutation or receipt

milestones.entry: Read project, receipt, revision, and projections, then cold restart and repeat from the packaged app

dimensions.H: User-visible creation, row selection, Skill/model selection, Agent read, approval, decline, restart
dimensions.B: Selection injection, context propagation, canonical operation, and three-surface projection
dimensions.E: Project payload, revision, receipt, approval/decline outcome, and duplicate-write evidence
dimensions.T: Electron renderer → preload → Host/MCP → project owner → persistence → fresh process → packaged app
dimensions.N: Missing surface, stale revision, wrong project, empty selection, decline, duplicate confirmation, and reconcile mismatch

naturalTaskVariants.H: 用户只表达短片目标、故事/分镜优先、第三镜头的自然修改和先确认后生成；观察可见 Skill/model、Agent 上下文与 approval 文案是否可理解。
naturalTaskVariants.B: 用户说‘第三个镜头’，内部必须解析为同一项目的第 3 行；仅该行进入提案，其他镜头和未提及字段保持不动，三面投影一致。
naturalTaskVariants.E: 用户先看‘改哪些’再确认；批准只写一次并留下 receipt/revision，拒绝不改项目、不写 receipt。
naturalTaskVariants.T: 自然语言从真实 Electron composer 经 preload/Host 到公共 MCP 语义调用，再落盘、重启回读并在 packaged app 重复；canonical tool/id 只在技术 assertion/receipt 中出现。
naturalTaskVariants.N: 同一自然任务覆盖空白项目无分镜、歧义‘第三个镜头’、错项目/旧 revision、空选择、拒绝、重复确认和重启 reconcile 不一致，并 fail closed。
